lines: These settings are found in the Storage Settings tab of your Pokémob's inventory. Coordinates are space separated world coordinates, these can be found by right clicking a block with the location linker, the results end up in your clipboard.
The Storage Location is required to be set for gathering, building or item management to occur.{_link_:_store_}

The first row of the storage settings is the Berry location. This is an optional location where you can put berries for your Pokémob, it will look here first for food, before looking in the Storage Location instead.
The second row of the storage settings is the Storage location. This is the coordinates of the block which contains the inventory to use.
The third row is then the direction from which to access the inventory, this allows storing items in specific sides of inventories, such as the fuel slot in a furnace
The fourth row is the Empty location. Your Pokémob will collect any items in this inventory.
The fifth row is the corresponding face from which to pull the items, allowing for say only pulling from the output of a furnace.
This system allows having a your Pokémob build structures from worldgeneration template files. These are the .nbt files found in the datapacks used to generate structures such as village buildings.

Only placeable blocks will be able to be built from the templates and inventories, etc will not be filled. You can also save existing structures for building, this allow saving empty spaces, and then having those selected, for clearing land.
Instructions should be in writable books, and placed in the Pokémob's offhand slot. Completed instructions will be moved into the Pokémob's held item slot.
<direction> is one of: NONE, CLOCKWISE_90, CLOCKWISE_180, COUNTERCLOCKWISE_90
And will construct either a single template, or a jigsaw from the template.
